title: thymus loscosii
intro: Thymus loscosii, commonly known as Thymus loscosii, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its essential oil, which has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Thymus loscosii include wound healing, digestion improvement, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
